h: Treat Thanksgiving to Cyber Monday as one event
b: Adobe expects Cyber Monday to stay the biggest day online ($15.1B) and Black Friday to grow fastest ($12.9B, +9.2%), with Cyber Week at $47.5B. Last year the Saturday and Sunday together ($11.8B) matched Black Friday on its own, so plan budget and creative for five days, not two.

h: Demand is pulling forward: be in market by early November
b: 71% of shoppers plan to buy before Black Friday, Adobe forecasts October at $95.8B and 28% expect their budget to be gone by the end of October. In 2025, Triple Whale brands spent the equivalent of 65% of their BFCM-weekend ad budget in the four days before it.

h: Growth is price, not more orders
b: Salesforce saw US Cyber Week orders grow just 1% in 2025 while prices rose, consumer sentiment finished October at 48.0, and 35% of shoppers are trading down. Bundles, gift-with-purchase and higher AOV will move results more than chasing order count.

h: Discounts are anchored at 20 to 40%: protect margin above that
b: Salesforce had the average Black Friday discount flat at 28% in 2025, Klaviyo merchants cut discounts 10% while sales grew, and 45% of shoppers say 20 to 40% off is enough. Adobe expects apparel to peak at 23% off on Black Friday.

h: Meta CPMs will spike, but judge on CPA, not CPM
b: Lebesgue saw the median Meta CPM 84% above September on Black Friday 2025 (fashion and footwear +66%), yet cost per purchase fell 20% because conversion rose 48%. Common Thread brands paid 26% more in November than October.

h: Don't cut early-November prospecting on 1-day ROAS
b: Northbeam measured a 36 to 37% gap between 1-day and 14-day attribution for one brand in BFCM week, and Haus found delayed lift 79% higher in Q4. Spend that looks weak in week one often closes on the peak days.

h: Brief Meta's auction once, then leave it alone
b: Meta's own peak-season guide: last year 42% of shoppers said they'd spend less and then spent 4.2% more, so the same audience holds cautious planners and confident buyers. Optimise for value, not volume, if that's what the business is paid on. Keep each ad set at roughly 50 conversions a week; below that Meta found cost per purchase about 28% higher. Make changes in one batch, take one learning phase, and hold it still.

h: Refresh creative weekly and audit Meta settings by 16 November
b: Near-weekly creative refreshes lifted day-7 ROAS 23% (AppLovin). Meta turned product browsing on by default on 28 Oct and new Commercial Terms start 20 Nov, a week before Black Friday: check placements, landing pages and tracking the week of 16 Nov.

h: Email and SMS carry the peak days
b: Email and SMS drove 43% of Klaviyo merchants' revenue on peak days in 2025, and Attentive SMS revenue per brand rose 42%. Inboxes will be crowded again: build lists before the event and keep the message simple.

h: AI shopping is small but the fastest-growing source
b: Adobe saw AI-referred retail traffic up 693% in the 2025 season, converting 31% better than other traffic, and forecasts another 130% this year. Clean product feeds and clear PDP copy are the prep.

h: Canada: smaller budgets, concentrated on Black Friday
b: Canadian holiday budgets are down (RCC/Leger $911, -6.5%; Deloitte $1,305, -14%), but 88% rank Black Friday in their top three days and 42% of budgets go online. 58% of those affected by US trade tensions are avoiding US brands. Last year Canadian Cyber Week online sales rose 7% at a 30% average discount.
